findings.detail: The clean checkout verifies the filing GAP guard considers missing or newer_revision, while CloseGapTransaction uses one ordered actionable set before and inside the single-flight lock. The focused public-entrypoint tests confirm revision-only binds and passes the exact amended accession; no parallel authorization model was introduced.
